 We shopped 147 early Black Friday sales to find the 98 best deals worth shopping now
 By Rikka Altland and Jacqueline Saguin , CNN Underscored
 Updated
 12:35 AM EST, Sat November 21, 2026
 Link Copied!
 Henry T. Casey/CNN Underscored

 Everything you need to know about Black Friday 
 Why trust CNN Underscored? 
 Black Friday is just a week away, but there’s no reason to wait until the clock strikes midnight on Nov. 27 to save. The secret to scoring the year’s best prices may have been shopping in the wee hours of the morning in the past, but in recent years, top retailers are giving you plenty of time to decide what to add to your cart. After covering the savings event for the past 12 years, CNN Underscored senior deals editor Rikka Altland is here to tell you that the year’s lowest prices are already live on everything from the perfect gift for a loved one and household essentials at a discount to latest tech and seasonal sales to score a new winter coat or space heater are already up for grabs.
 Just because Black Friday sales start earlier and earlier each year doesn’t mean every discount live ahead of the end of the month is actually worth adding to your cart, though. That’s why we shopped around at 147 of the best retailers to find the 98 best early markdowns that are already hovering around their expected Black Friday prices .

 Early Black Friday deals at major retailers
 • Amazon : Save on tech, home goods, kitchen essentials and more at Amazon during its annual Black Friday event. If the retailer sells it, odds are it’s already on sale ahead of Thanksgiving week.
 • Apple : The best deals on just about everything Apple sells are live, helping you score a new MacBook, iPad, Apple Watch or official accessories like AirPods and AirTags for less.
 • Best Buy : This time of year is know as being the opportune time to upgrade your tech. Whether you’re looking to save on a new TV, noise-canceling headphones , appliances or some other gadget, Best Buy has you covered with its early Black Friday sale.
 • Lowe’s﻿ : Everything you need to tackle those final home improvement projects before winter arrives is already on sale ahead of Black Friday.
 • Nordstrom : Refresh your wardrobe for winter with deals on everything from everyday basics from brands like Ralph Lauren and Levi’s to designer pieces and more.
 • REI : Gear up for colder weather and save as much as 50% across a catalog of outdoor clothing from top brands like Patagonia, Arc’teryx, Salomon and Merrell.
